verifications.claim: The Philadelphia Phillies open the 2026 MLB season at home against the Texas Rangers on Thursday, March 26, 2026, at 3:05 p.m. ET at Citizens Bank Park.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R3: 'Texas Rangers at Philadelphia Phillies (1:15 p.m.)'; R5: 'The Phillies open the season at 4:15 p.m. on March 26 against the Texas Rangers at Citizens Bank Park.'
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm Phillies host Rangers on Thursday, March 26, 2026, at Citizens Bank Park, but list conflicting start times of 1:15 p.m. and 4:15 p.m., neither matching the claimed 3:05 p.m. ET.

verifications.claim: Justin Crawford and Andrew Painter made the Philadelphia Phillies' 2026 Opening Day roster.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R4: 'Crawford... wasn’t on last year’s Opening Day roster'; R5: 'Justin Crawford... Andrew Painter... made the roster'; R6: 'Andrew Painter... on Philadelphia's Opening Day roster'; R7: 'ro rookies Justin Crawford and Andrew Painter had both made the club'; R8: 'ro rookies Andrew Painter and Justin Crawford on the roster.'
